layers.name: Presentation
layers.description: User interfaces and delivery entrypoints: Streamlit web dashboard (app.py) and CLI automation commands (shared.cli). Translates user or CI input into application workflows.

layers.name: Application
layers.description: Multi-agent workflows and high-level use-case orchestration: SRS Generation multi-agent pipeline (generation.*), Self-Healing autonomous remediation agent (healing.*), and end-to-end audit pipelines.

layers.name: Domain
layers.description: Core deterministic logic, data models, and analysis engines: AST static dependency parser (extraction.py), NetworkX reality graph (graph.py), deterministic rule verification engine (checker.py), and Pydantic ruleset contracts (shared.schema).

layers.name: Infrastructure
layers.description: External integration drivers and presentation renderers: External LLM provider client adapters (classifier_agent.py, generation.llm), file system/zip handlers, and interactive vis-network HTML canvas generator (visualize.py).

layers.name: Observability
layers.description: System monitoring, telemetry, and metrics export: Prometheus metrics exporter (monitoring latency, health scores, LLM token costs), health checks, and Docker containerization hooks.

rules.reason: Presentation triggers Generation workflows and Self-Healing remediation passes.
Presentation displays Domain structures like the Reality Graph and Architecture Health Score.
Presentation loads the interactive vis-network HTML canvas component.
Generation pipeline outputs validated Pydantic rulesets; Healing agent consumes Conformance violations.
Generation agents and Healing agents query external LLMs through infrastructure adapters.
Infrastructure adapters instantiate and populate Domain entities and schema models.
Prometheus metric collectors record health scores and violation metrics directly from the Domain engine.
Observability tracks workflow duration, iteration counts, and LLM token usage across agents.
